name: Probabilistic analysis
blurb: Monte Carlo as-built variations of an HR Steel design — E, plate thickness, story out-of-plumb drawn from the literature — re-analysed with the design's own LRFD model and checked against its own AISC 360 capacities. Where would you take a second look?

tabs.title: Probabilistic
tabs.blurb: Load this project's HR Steel design (or any package), choose the number of as-built variations (default 100), run, and read the distribution of the maximum member and connection D/C against the design's own values. Runs in the Nonlinear module's environment; nothing is recomputed on the capacity side.
